issue.title: Linked-from stage: ⇧↵ on a 💬 mention row turns it into a relation (opens S's Links stage prefilled with T)

task_type_fields.proposal:
Proposed by bob-cli-e8.9 note #2; listed in the "Follow-ups" section of plan 202610/inline_task_mentions.md (epic bob-cli-e8) as deliberately outside that epic.

Today a `(💬 mentions)` entry on T's 🪢 LINKED FROM line is inert: the Linked-from stage (bob-navigation-hotkeys) refuses toggle/remove on mention rows, and docs/guides/see-task-mentions.md tells Bryan to turn a mention into a relation by hand (add a LINKS entry from S with `~`/`~~` or Task Card `l`/`⇧L`).

Proposal: ⇧↵ on a mention row in the Linked-from stage opens S's Links stage prefilled with T as the target. A label is prefilled only from non-closing labels, so a prose "Duplicate of [[…]]" never prefills a configured `relations.cancel_labels` / `complete_labels` entry. Once the relation is written, the existing identity delta replaces the mention entry (relation wins, M7 in docs/task-relations.md §19). Update the stage footer hints, docs/task-relations.md §9/§19, the nav docs, and the guide.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The bob-cli-e8 plan (Follow-ups section) explicitly excluded 'Make it a relation…' from the inline task mentions epic, which shipped mentions as inert entries with no gestures.

issue.creation_reason: Out-of-scope follow-up named in the bob-cli-e8 plan and proposed by bob-cli-e8.9 note #2; mentions are inert by design, so converting one needs its own gesture.
